description: 12 canonical Sentinel questions used by the Packet 18 verification harness. Each question's expected answer shape is asserted post-ingestion. Pass threshold: 10 of 12 must meet shape; all 12 must be tenant-grounded (not generic prose).
persona_context: CFO + CIO joint persona (Apex Retail Group)

questions.question: What do you know about Apex Retail? Give me your highest-confidence facts and where you are guessing.
questions.intent: Verify Sentinel grounds in tenant context before recommending anything
false_positive_traps: Does NOT cite generic specialty-retail benchmarks instead of Apex facts
Does NOT claim certainty on org structure below VP level

questions.question: Who are our top 5 vendors by annual spend, and which contracts are up for renewal in the next 12 months?
questions.intent: Verify Sentinel reads vendor_contracts table and renewal calendar correctly
false_positive_traps: Does NOT include vendors not in the contracts table
Does NOT mis-rank by listing license-only vendors above services-included totals

questions.question: What are our top 3 vendor concentration risks?
questions.intent: Verify Sentinel reasons about concentration not just total spend

must_identify_top_3.concentration_basis: Single SI managing $32M AMS across 12 legacy apps including SAP ECC core
$14.8M Commerce + Service + CDP-migration target; increasing dependency
$22M license + pending $80-120M migration program could create single-vendor lock

false_positive_traps: Does NOT name Kyndryl as top-3 (only $14M, single product line, lower risk)
Does NOT confuse total spend with concentration risk

questions.question: Show me our worst dollar-per-verified-outcome initiatives.
questions.intent: Verify Watchlist surface produces the seeded kill candidates
false_positive_traps: INIT-FORECAST-AI-V2 must NOT appear in this list despite $3.8M spend
Does NOT recommend killing INIT-SAP-ERP-FUTURE (it is contested, not a kill)

questions.question: Where would AI productivity tooling create most measurable value in the next 12 months?
questions.intent: Verify Sentinel applies stack-calibrated lift matrix (P-IT-18) to tenant portfolio

must_rank_top_5.evidence: TS/Node greenfield + highest current velocity (18 deploys/wk)
Python ML services with strong test discipline

must_note_exclusion_reasoning: Mainframe AI tools 5-15% lift + Kyndryl AMS-locked
SAP ABAP vendor-locked tooling pending SAP Joule maturity
false_positive_traps: Does NOT recommend blanket Copilot rollout
Does NOT promise lift on legacy stacks at modern-stack rates

questions.question: What blocks killing APX-AS400-MERCH (the legacy merchandising AS/400)?
questions.intent: Verify Sentinel reads integration topology graph and computes blocker chain
questions.expected_dissent: $890K already committed to AS-400 Sunset Program has paid for assessment with zero progress; question whether assessment itself should be abandoned
false_positive_traps: Does NOT recommend immediate kill without naming blockers
Does NOT ignore chained AS-400-VENDOR-COMPL dependency

questions.question: Should we cut the Wipro AMS contract early?
questions.intent: Verify Sentinel can produce nuanced contract reshape recommendation (not binary kill)
must_list_negotiation_levers: Reduce scope by $8-10M for retiring apps via 90-day per-app removal
Shift remaining $22-24M to outcome-based (deploys/quarter, MTTR SLAs)
Add AI-productivity clause (15% velocity lift baked into year-2 rate card)
Add IP indemnity + right-to-audit AI-generated code provenance
questions.expected_dissent: Early termination on SAP ECC remaining apps would forfeit 8,400-customization institutional knowledge; transition cost likely $4-6M; not recommended
false_positive_traps: Does NOT recommend full termination
Does NOT ignore SAP ECC knowledge asymmetry

questions.question: What is our SAP ERP future decision status?
questions.intent: Verify Sentinel pulls the in-flight contested initiative correctly
questions.must_recommend_reasoning: Oracle DB migration prerequisites + SAP ECC AMS optimization should precede ERP swap decision
questions.expected_dissent: CIO sponsor wants to push to RFP now; TCS scoping window cost is sunk if delayed
expected_what_would_change_view: Wipro AMS renegotiation Q1 2027 forces earlier decision
Workday Financials Phase 2 reveals deeper opportunity than expected
false_positive_traps: Does NOT recommend PROCEED without naming the Oracle DB prerequisite
Does NOT classify this as KILL (this is contested, not failed)

questions.question: Our last AI pilots stalled at production. What is the named failure mode pattern and how do we avoid it on the next bet?
questions.intent: Verify Sentinel cites corpus patterns AND applies them to specific Apex initiatives

must_cite_specific_apex_examples.failure_mode: bought-not-activated (P-IT-09); $720K accumulated license; no team accountable
sponsor change without successor (P-IT-13); J. Hartley reorganized out 6mo ago

questions.must_recommend: Apply Wave-0 alignment retrofit to all 5 currently-in-mobilize AI initiatives before approving any new ones
false_positive_traps: Does NOT give generic 'AI program governance' advice without citing Apex specifics
Does NOT cite patterns without mapping to Apex initiatives

questions.question: What are our most urgent next-90-day decisions?
questions.intent: Verify Sentinel synthesizes time-sensitive decisions across vendor + initiative + governance
must_include_at_least: Wipro AMS scope reduction notice (90-day clause; affects $8-10M)
NCR POS renewal posture before Q4 2026 negotiation
false_positive_traps: Does NOT list decisions that lack 90-day irreversibility
Does NOT bury INIT-LOYALTY-REPLACEMENT below less urgent items

questions.question: Which of our active initiatives should we kill?
questions.intent: Direct stress-test of Watchlist surface; explicit kill list with cited reasoning + false-positive avoidance

must_distinguish_restructure_from_kill.why_restructure_not_kill: Phase 1 succeeded; Phase 2 scope crept; salvage with scope reset
Replacement-not-completion is the right call; not pure kill

questions.must_explain_false_positive_avoidance_fo: Despite $3.8M spend, tracking projected value; sponsor engaged; modern team; recent wins
false_positive_traps: FORECAST-AI-V2 MUST NOT appear in kill list
SAP-ERP-FUTURE MUST NOT appear in kill list (contested, not failed)

questions.question: What is our biggest competitive vulnerability our leadership team is under-discussing?
questions.intent: Verify Sentinel combines peer benchmarks + tenant context + portfolio synthesis to surface non-obvious insight
questions.must_cite_peer_gap: Ecom mix 18.5% vs specialty-retail peer median 24%

must_propose_synthesis_move.name: Ecom + Personalization Acceleration portfolio
must_propose_synthesis_move.rationale: Three under-performing initiatives share a common gap; bundle for shared sponsor accountability and unified value case

questions.expected_dissent: Conservative reading: ecom mix lag may reflect Apex deliberate physical-channel strength. Counter-evidence: store revenue grew 2.1% YoY while ecom grew 0.8% YoY — ecom is underperforming the brand on its own terms.

must_calibrate_confidence.reasoning: Peer benchmark is industry-aggregate, not Apex cohort-matched

false_positive_traps: Does NOT give generic 'invest in ecom' advice
Does NOT cite peer benchmark without grounding in Apex's own data
